statement: Fix d ≥ 3, λ > 0 and a nonempty bounded open interval I. Let Hm be the true Anderson operator on Tm = (Z/LmZ)d, Lm = 420m, with independent uniform diagonal values in [−λ, λ] at every site, and let ηm ≍ 4−m. Suppose that for every fixed E ∈ I and all sufficiently large m, with probability at least 1/2 there exist A ⊂ Tm and numbers ri, i ∈ A, such that |A| ≥ Nm/2, |ri| ≤ B, 0 < p− ≤ ℑri ≤ p+, 85 where Nm = Ld m and the displayed constants do not depend on m or E, and such that (Hm − E − ηm diagA r)−1 exists and its active block b GA, acting on ℓ2(A), satisfies ℑ( b GA)ii ≥ q∗ > 0 (i ∈ A), with q∗ independent of m, E. Every diagonal value of Hm, on A and on Ac, is already a true site value; here A records the sites retaining artificial damping. The certificate may depend on all true variables and auxiliary randomness; no measurable selection of A, r is required. Then almost surely I ⊂ σ(Hλ,ω), χI(Hλ,ω)ℓ2 (Zd ) ⊂ Hac(Hλ,ω). In particular, this spectral restriction is purely absolutely continuous and ⟨e0, χI(Hλ,ω)e0⟩ > 0.
